title: Get comfortable with Python
summary: Build a foundation: store values, work with text, and control what your program does.

lessons.title: Values and variables
topics: Run your first Python program
Store numbers and text in named variables
Understand strings, integers, and floats
Use print() to see your results
lessons.quizSummary: Identify a value’s type and choose a valid variable name.

lessons.title: Working with strings
topics: Create and join pieces of text
Insert variables with f-strings
Clean text with strip() and lower()
Read a response with input()
lessons.quizSummary: Choose the expression that formats and cleans a message.

lessons.title: Making decisions
topics: Compare values with ==, >, and <
Write if, elif, and else branches
Combine conditions with and / or
Build a simple decision-based program
lessons.quizSummary: Predict which branch runs for a given input.

lessons.title: Repeating with loops
topics: Repeat an action with a for loop
Generate number sequences with range()
Use a while loop for repeated input
Recognize when a loop should stop
lessons.quizSummary: Trace a loop and predict its output.

title: Work with real-world data
summary: Collect information and read or save it in files.

lessons.title: A place for everything: lists
topics: Create a list of related values
Find an item by its index
Add or remove items with append() and remove()
Loop over a list to process every item
lessons.quizSummary: Choose how to add, access, and remove list items.

lessons.title: Dictionaries
topics: Represent information with key–value pairs
Read a value using its key
Add and update dictionary entries
Combine a dictionary with a list
lessons.quizSummary: Match keys to values and update an entry.

lessons.title: Reading files
topics: Open a text file with a with block
Read a whole file or one line at a time
Clean each line before using it
Handle a missing file gracefully
lessons.quizSummary: Choose a safe way to read and close a file.

lessons.title: Writing files
topics: Create a text file with write mode
Add to a file with append mode
Write text and newline characters
Save a small set of records
lessons.quizSummary: Explain when to use write versus append.

title: Make your code reusable
summary: Organize your logic, handle mistakes, and reuse useful tools.

lessons.title: Functions
topics: Define a function with def
Call a function from your program
Return a result to the caller
Split a repeated task into a named function
lessons.quizSummary: Distinguish returning a value from printing it.

lessons.title: Parameters
topics: Pass data into a function
Use more than one parameter
Set a sensible default value
Keep local variables inside a function
lessons.quizSummary: Choose arguments that match a function’s parameters.

lessons.title: Handling errors
topics: Read a Python error message
Catch an expected error with try / except
Validate a user’s input
Show a useful recovery message
lessons.quizSummary: Choose the error handling for invalid input.

lessons.title: Useful modules
topics: Import a standard library module
Use pathlib to describe file paths
Explore files and folders safely
Read a function’s documentation
lessons.quizSummary: Pick the module and function for a file task.

title: Build something useful
summary: Bring the pieces together in a small file organizer project.

lessons.title: Plan your file organizer
topics: Define what the organizer should do
Choose a small set of file categories
Break the task into functions
Plan a safe folder for experimenting
lessons.quizSummary: Put the project steps into a useful order.

lessons.title: Build the first version
topics: List the files in a sample folder
Read and categorize file extensions
Create destination folders
Move sample files into their categories
lessons.quizSummary: Choose the correct rule for categorizing a file.

lessons.title: Test and improve
topics: Try an empty folder and unknown file types
Handle an existing destination filename
Use a dry run before moving files
Make errors understandable
lessons.quizSummary: Identify a missing test or an unsafe behavior.

lessons.title: Make it yours
topics: Add a category that matters to you
Let the user choose a source folder
Document how to run your organizer
Review the skills you can use next
lessons.quizSummary: Apply variables, functions, and files in a final recap.
